description: This source file provides an extension to VoiceWakeOverlayController, implementing UI management functions such as presenting, ensuring the window exists, bringing the overlay to the front, calculating frame sizes, updating the window frame, measuring height, and handling dismissal behavior for the voice wake overlay in a macOS application.

classes.name: VoiceWakeOverlayController
classes.description: A controller class managing the voice wake overlay window and its interactions.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays the voice wake overlay window, initializing it if necessary, and manages the overlay's presentation logic.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Initializes the overlay window and hosting view if they are not already created.

methods.name: bringToFrontIfVisible
methods.description: Brings the overlay window to the front if it is currently visible.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates and returns the frame rectangle where the overlay window should appear based on screen size.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the overlay window's frame to match the target frame, with optional animation.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates and returns the height needed for the overlay content based on the text and UI layout.

methods.name: dismissTargetFrame
methods.description: Determines the target frame for dismissing the overlay based on the reason and outcome provided.
